semantic_review: Root read the original Python, public acceptance statement, actual integer expression tree, byte reads/writes, native program/grid/host composition, typed scalar expressions, admission, metadata/physical bindings and conditional refinement. All source grouped coordinates retain pid%group_size and each actual constexpr/i32/i64 promotion and intermediate wrap, including singleton large strides and negative active masks. Input and output pointers sign-extend selected offsets and wrap at64bits; active accesses alone are classified. The whole input tile loads before the unmasked inverse and concrete output stores. Host abs/max traverses the logical strided view and its original maximum/inverse are physically written before kernel execution; returned maximum is not substituted with the reciprocal. Independent plans use host-prepared bytes, actual masks/addresses and independent scalar expressions; evolving-memory execution is related by input/inverse-output disjointness. Every launch and finite autotune trial is composed, ownership is reset per launch, output bytes have an independent last-write formula and exterior frame, and returned max/inverse bytes are preserved. The main theorem has no Safe/ArithmeticRefines premise: actual grid-limit, access/ownership/missing-byte/integer-division/conversion observations and successful actual-address returns are partitioned. Observations assert no native trap, rollback or postfailure state. Ordinary signed64 Torch metadata and concrete fresh allocation remain trusted primitives; all22 canonical CPU/CUDA dtype families retain source-first abs/max/rank/stride/signature/llrint/pointer failures and primitive exceptions. Eight admitted scalar storage routes retain exact promotions, nested multiplication, defined nearest-even llrint64 and int8 narrowing, with all16 numerical families/140ports precisely registered. The logical transpose formula is conditional on ArithmeticRefines and does not exclude safe wrapped actual-address executions. Existing fp32 source interpreter and proofs remain connected through the legacy bridge. Root rechecked every producer/peer artifact and dependency, all863 case schemas and all140 omitted-port rejections; the independently rebuilt18 peer modules have68 named clean axiom checks and14 noncircular checks. Root also independently rebuilt all18 final modules with68 named clean axiom checks and14 noncircular checks. The producer dependency snapshots omitted one direct external import, Mathlib.Data.List.Range; root captured its current object before its first independent build and verified it unchanged afterward, without claiming a historical producer hash. The first isolated root build lacked dependency object links and failed before elaboration; its source/log/receipt are retained, links were supplied, and the second complete build passed. Current repository build and full authority/catalog/ledger integration remain required before acceptance.

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.
configuration.grid_domain: Host cdiv grid uses exact nonnegative integers; CUDA grid-x requires gridM*gridN<2^31, otherwise gridLimit observation. This is a target launch prerequisite, not an address-safety inference.
configuration.returned_semantics: NativeResult specifies independent actual-address write plan, returned tensors, every final byte, and untouched-byte frame. Mathematical transpose additionally follows under optional ArithmeticRefines; it is not a premise of the main outcome theorem.
configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.
configuration.grid_domain: Host cdiv grid uses exact nonnegative integers; CUDA grid-x requires gridM*gridN<2^31, otherwise gridLimit observation. This is a target launch prerequisite, not an address-safety inference.
configuration.returned_semantics: NativeResult specifies independent actual-address write plan, returned tensors, every final byte, and untouched-byte frame. Mathematical transpose additionally follows under optional ArithmeticRefines; it is not a premise of the main outcome theorem.
configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.
configuration.grid_domain: Host cdiv grid uses exact nonnegative integers; CUDA grid-x requires gridM*gridN<2^31, otherwise gridLimit observation. This is a target launch prerequisite, not an address-safety inference.
configuration.returned_semantics: NativeResult specifies independent actual-address write plan, returned tensors, every final byte, and untouched-byte frame. Mathematical transpose additionally follows under optional ArithmeticRefines; it is not a premise of the main outcome theorem.
configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else valid_matrix

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.returned_semantics: NativeResult specifies independent actual-address write plan, returned tensors, every final byte, and untouched-byte frame. Mathematical transpose additionally follows under optional ArithmeticRefines; it is not a premise of the main outcome theorem.

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.
